text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Bubble-saaaan! Help meee!
My underclassmen are super mad desu!
They said, "You're taking too long in the shower!"...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Huh? A shower?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Water is... a waste.
However—that's nonsense..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Well, you see.
It all started because our "Inter-Dorm Water-Saving Battle"
got way too heated.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It all began with a minor squabble among some students
after they looked at the dormitory operation records...

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Fufun♪
Our dorm saved a ton of water this month, didn't we?
Hishi Ama-senpai is totally gonna praise me for this~!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, we won last month, didn't we?
If we buckle down right now, we can totally win this month too!
Ritto is way more amazing, you know!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It was only meant to be casual conversation topic,
but before long, the underclassmen seem to have become a bit too enthusiastic about it...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"You're all doing great, yes...
But if you just endure it all,
you're putting the cart before the horse—backwards!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
That truly is putting the cart before the horse.
Besides, you won't be able to keep that up for long.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Well then, what should I do... Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I've made up my mind!
Could everyone lend me a hand?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Ununu~... Gotta wash my face quick!
No, maybe I should just wipe it off instead...!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Hold on, that's not gonna give you any closure. You won't be able to sleep well, you know?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Senpai...
But at this rate, we're going to lose to Ritto this month.
I can't just drag everyone down...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Immediate victories... are meaningless. Only perseverance... will protect Japan's beautiful, soft water...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The books on the environment and saving money said
we should think long-term. Besides, if you can't get
a proper rest, it'll affect your races...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Ugh... But...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: It would break my heart if your running were clouded by stress.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Rather than a single win... isn't the mindset of
"staying careful for a lifetime" what really matters?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Everyone... u-ugh...!
To be honest, it was pretty tough for me too...
But I couldn't just back out nowww...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Really!?
Mmh~~! Time for a big comforting hug!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see. Your intentions are truly admirable.
Shall we discuss it with everyone in the dorm tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Hishi Amazon and
Bubble Gum Fellow at the cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Man, you really saved me the other day, Bubble!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Still, it's pathetic that I let them beat me to the punch.
Who knew things had gotten to that point?"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, don't worry about it.
It's my job to cut through the front lines at times like this.
choice_data_list: What are you two talking about?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer.
Actually, at our dorm—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that's what happened.
It really is important to take the long view. In all things...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
What's important,
I think, is the desire to keep striving for victory.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: "To work hard toward that, and keep chasing good results... right?"
choice_data_list: Maybe that mindset is the secret to your power?
I want to learn from that mindset.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Ah, yeah, that might be true!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Not just me, but Taiki and the others too!
I guess that's why they're so strong in races.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, feel free to follow my example.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
If Trainer coaches me from that perspective,
I feel like I could become even stronger.
